title: AWS Backend Developer
description: Senior AWS Backend Developer with DynamoDB experience

parameters.name: AWS SDK Integration
parameters.description: Understanding of AWS SDK v3 and DynamoDB integration

questions.question: Can you explain the key benefits of using DynamoDB over traditional relational databases for this type of application?
How would you handle eventual consistency in DynamoDB when your application requires strong consistency for certain operations?
Describe how you would implement efficient pagination for large datasets in DynamoDB.

parameters.name: API Design & Error Handling
parameters.description: RESTful API design and proper error handling

questions.question: What are the key principles you follow when designing RESTful APIs, and how do you ensure they are maintainable?
How do you implement comprehensive error handling in a Node.js API that provides meaningful feedback to clients while maintaining security?
Describe your approach to API versioning and backward compatibility when you need to make breaking changes.

parameters.name: Production Readiness
parameters.description: Production-ready code with logging, monitoring, and best practices

questions.question: What monitoring and logging strategies do you implement for production Node.js applications?
How do you handle configuration management and secrets in a production environment?
Describe your approach to implementing health checks and graceful shutdown in a containerized application.
